abstracts.content:
We study backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs for short) on a probability
space equipped with a Brownian filtration. We assume that the data are merely
integrable. Moreover, the generator is imposed to satisfy monotonicity condition with
respect to the value variable (with no restrictions on the growth) and to be Lipschitz
continuous with respect to the control variable. We provide an a priori estimate and
stability result for solutions to the studied BSDEs.
